verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents several named public APIs, including the Legal Entity Management API and the Configuration API. It also offers an API-only onboarding path and split instructions on payment endpoints, so the core platform workflows can be driven programmatically. The OpenAPI probe found nothing at the guessed paths, but that only means no spec was located there; it does not contradict the documented APIs. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API reference and authentication detail in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Build your own UI and collect required user data. You make API requests to create resources and submit the user data to Adyen.
To manage legal entities, use the Legal Entity Management API.
You can create balance accounts manually using the Configuration API.
